title: Disapproval of filings.
bodyText: If the commissioner finds that a filing does not meet the requirements of this chapter in whole or in part and disapproves the filing, a written request for a hearing may be filed pursuant to section 431:14G-112. The insurer shall bear the burden of proving that the filing meets the requirements of this article.
bodyHtml: [§431:10H-228.5]  Disapproval of filings.  If the commissioner finds that a filing does not meet the requirements of this chapter in whole or in part and disapproves the filing, a written request for a hearing may be filed pursuant to section 431:14G-112.  The insurer shall bear the burden of proving that the filing meets the requirements of this article. [L 2017, c 151, §2]
